meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分诊问题与外部PR，生成可执行的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在维护开源项目，常被大量Issue和外部PR淹没，需要快速分诊归类。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an open-source project and need a fast way to sort incoming issues and external PRs.

howto.what: 用一套 triage 状态机处理 issue 和外部 PR：给出 bug 或 enhancement 分类以及 needs-triage、needs-info、ready-for-agent 等状态，核验问题是否成立，必要时逐条追问，并写出供 agent 使用的简报。
howto.when: 由维护者手动输入 /triage 并用自然语言说明要做什么时接管，例如查看哪些事项需要处理，或处理某个指定的 issue 或 PR。

say.text: 看看有哪些 issue 和 PR 需要我处理

say.note: 先读上下文，再给出分类和状态建议
直接应用该状态，跳过追问环节

howto.what_en: Runs issues and external PRs through a triage state machine: assigns a bug/enhancement category and a state, verifies the claim, grills when needed, and writes agent-ready briefs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the maintainer types /triage and describes a request in natural language, such as reviewing what needs attention or triaging a specific issue or PR.

say_en.text: Show me anything that needs my attention
say_en.note: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage and needs-info items.
Reads context, then suggests a category and state.
Applies the role directly, skipping grilling.
